answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 25 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in opal, verified in oasis, and onyx names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 192 dollars and 14 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
